question: Which of the following is NOT an inner planet of our solar system?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jupiter**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Solar System contains 8 planets:

 
 

 Inner or Terrestrial planets

 
 
 
 
 
 
• Mercury
 
• Venus
 
• Earth
 
• Mars
 
 
 
 

 
 Outer Planets or Jovian planets

 
 
 
 
 
 
• Jupiter
 
• Saturn
 
• Uranus
 
• Neptune
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Venus and Earth are almost the same size, have about the same mass (they weigh about the same), and have a very similar composition (are made of the same material).
 
• Venus is considered as Earth’s-twin because its size and shape are very much similar to that of the earth.
 
• Venus is the second planet from the Sun and is the brightest planet in the solar system.
 
• It is sometimes referred to as the sister planet to Earth, because of its similar mass and size.
 
• The planet is named after the Roman goddess of love and beauty.
 
• Venus is the brightest planet and is easily noticeable with unaided eyes.
 
• One of the earliest Babylonian astronomical documents speaks about Venus.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **Shortcut Trick__**
